description: CAIRO Medicines looks up medicines authorised in the EU and the US and returns the regulator-published label text itself, with the product, document, section, source URL and date attached to every passage. Users can find a medicine by brand name or active ingredient, narrow a broad section to the specific warning they asked about, review the version history of a label, and find the official adverse-event reporting route for their jurisdiction. When a name matches more than one product it lists the candidates instead of choosing one, and for markets outside the EU and US it states the limitation rather than substituting another market's label.

defaultPrompt: Search the EU medicines catalogue for a product and show its governed product details and available official documents.
Retrieve a healthcare-professional warning from an official medicine label and show the passage with full provenance.
Show the official adverse-event reporting routes for a jurisdiction, including audience, source, and verification status.
